title: Lob It Over
style: afro jazz, female lead vocal, live drums and brass, 88 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
The lob is a weapon.
Not a desperate shot.
In every language, same strategy.

[VERSE 1 - English]
When they crowd the net move them back
Lift it high and let it track
Deep lob over their heads
Force them back to their baseline threads

[VERSE 2 - Sindhi transliteration]
Jad hoo net te aaven, khen pechhe hatao
Ucho karo ane track thaiva dao
Khori lob unna jee matha te
Khen wapass baseline te aaira

[VERSE 3 - Occitan transliteration]
Quand s'acoston al filet, mandatz-los en darriera
Ausatz-lo naut e daisatz-lo tracar
Lob prond sus lor testa
Fortsatz-los a tornar a la linha de fons

[CHORUS]
LOB - ALTO - NAUT - UCHAAN
LIFT IT HIGH - PUSH THEM BACK
LOB ATTACK - EVERY COURT
DEEP AND OVER - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Afrikaans]
Wanneer hulle die net verdring, stoot hulle terug
Hef dit hoog en laat dit loop
Diepe lob oor hulle koppe
Dwing hulle terug na hulle basislyn

[VERSE 5 - Yoruba transliteration -- new verse, different from prior]
Ngba ti won ba sun mo apapo, fi won pada
Gbe e ga ki o si tele ipa re
Lob jin lori ori won
Fipa mu won pada si ila ipile won

[VERSE 6 - Armenian transliteration]
Er'b nrank marzen cankutyuny, het kacets nrantz
Barts karc ev thuyk ta hatak el
Ej lob nrantz girky veri
Stipets nrantz veraprunel bazayin gits

[CHORUS]
LOB - ALTO - NAUT - UCHAAN
LIFT IT HIGH - PUSH THEM BACK
LOB ATTACK - EVERY COURT
DEEP AND OVER - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Sindhi. Occitan. Afrikaans. Armenian.
The lob is not a mistake.
It is a choice.
Lift it. Deep. Over.

[FINAL CHORUS]
LOB - ALTO - NAUT - UCHAAN
LIFT IT HIGH - PUSH THEM BACK
LOB ATTACK - EVERY COURT
DEEP AND OVER - EVERY TIME
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE LIFT
PUSH THEM BACK - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every language. Every court.
Lob it over.
